5. As Langstaff J said:
“It is well known that those who have disabilities may suffer from social, attitudinal, or
environmental difficulties. There may be barriers to their achieving the rights to which
as human beings they ought to be entitled. We therefore take the purpose of making an
adjustment as being to overcome such barriers so far as access to court is concerned, in
particular to enable a party to give the full and proper account that they would wish to give
to the tribunal, as best they can be helped to give it. We accept that practical guidance as

v University of Oxford [2020] ICR 1294, para. 18.
